scenery.name: carving
description:
Carved into the bars surface is a poem
 "As I went down the hill along the wall 
There was a gate I had leaned at for the view  
And had just turned from when I first saw you  
As you came up the hill. We met. But all  
We did that day was mingle great and small  
Footprints in summer dust as if we drew  
The figure of our being less than two  
But more than one as yet. Your parasol  
Pointed the decimal off with one deep thrust.  
And all the time we talked you seemed to see  
Something down there to smile at in the dust.  
(Oh, it was without prejudice to me!)  
Afterward I went past what you had passed  
Before we met and you what I had passed." - Robert Frost

rooms.name: Walts ATM
rooms.description:
This small area houses a blinking machine that allows bank transactions. Walt in typical fashion looks as if he hooked this ATM up after finding it in the wastelands after years of rot. It appears to be connected to the dimensional network allowing you to deposit and withdrawl anywhere an ATM is available. 
A sign you can read hangs here.

scenery.name: sign
description: A sign you can read.

- This bank requires a minimum balance to open an account.
To use any of the bank's services, you must first open an
account for 100 credits (see below as to how).

- This bank charges for certain transactions, such as
currency exchange.

To conduct business here:

request account from ATM
request balance from ATM
ask ATM to deposit AMOUNT CURRENCY
ask ATM to withdraw AMOUNT CURRENCY

examples:

request account from atm
request balance from atm
ask atm to deposit 100 credit
ask atm to withdraw 10 credit
The sign preserves the old banking instructions. Banking services are not active in this port; credits remain in your character balance.

scenery.name: atm
description: The ATM is a floor mounted machine with a small screen and fingerprint scanner. The device is connected to the dimesional network as evidenced by the small sparks of static that can be seen in the back. Another clue is the small sign on the front that reads "Galactix Banking" which has been seen as the best bank known for their small fees and ubiqutous ATMs.
